title: About Jeremiah
content: Jeremiah Onwoh is a Technical Systems & Infrastructure Engineer with 15+ years of hands-on experience across networking, systems and network administration, cloud engineering, security, DevOps and technical support. His career grew from network and systems administration into cloud engineering, DevOps and infrastructure automation, and more recently into agentic AI and LLM infrastructure — building RAG systems, local LLM deployments and AI agents with tools like Ollama, LiteLLM, Qdrant, pgvector and ChromaDB.

title: Core skills
content: Cloud & DevOps: AWS, Kubernetes, Docker, infrastructure as code, CI/CD. AI & LLMs: generative AI, local LLM deployment (Ollama, LiteLLM), AI agents, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), MCP, vector databases (ChromaDB, Qdrant), chatbots. Security & Reliability: network and cloud security, RBAC, ITGC & ITAC, IT compliance. Automation & Code: Python, Bash, JavaScript, Node.js, n8n, API integration. Networks & Systems: Linux, TCP/IP, VPN, MikroTik, systems administration. Observability & Tooling: Prometheus, Grafana, Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, SonarQube, Portainer, DataDog.

title: Project: Local LLM & AI Automation Lab
content: An ongoing project experimenting with Ollama, open-source models, LiteLLM and n8n to build practical local AI and agentic workflows, including a Telegram-triggered research agent.

title: Project: Job Hunter Agent (securejobs)
content: An open-source, local-first career automation platform that ingests job postings directly from Greenhouse, Lever and Ashby, deterministically filters and scores them against a candidate profile, stores postings with vector embeddings in PostgreSQL/pgvector, and uses local LLMs via Ollama to generate tailored resumes, cover letters and interview prep — with Telegram and email alerts for high-scoring matches.

title: Project: Athena AI
content: A self-hosted, voice-enabled personal assistant built on local quantized LLMs via Ollama, with FastAPI orchestration, Qdrant for long-term semantic memory, Whisper for local voice transcription, and direct integration with Obsidian and Joplin notes. It monitors system resources, manages Docker containers and executes shell commands through structured tool-calling, running fully offline for privacy.

title: Project: Learn Igbo AI (IgboAmaka)
content: IgboAmaka is a local-first, open-source language-learning platform for Standard Igbo. It combines an 8,485-word dictionary, user corrections and a CPU-optimized NLLB-200 model in a cascading fallback architecture, with context-aware audio to resolve Igbo homophones (tone-dependent words). It runs entirely offline, aimed at closing the gap in AI tooling for under-served African languages.

title: Project: Cloud & Kubernetes Labs
content: Hands-on infrastructure environments covering containers, Kubernetes, infrastructure as code with Terraform, CI/CD pipelines with Jenkins and GitLab CI/CD, and monitoring with Prometheus and Grafana.

title: Project: RAG-Powered Chatbot Assistant
content: An open-source, self-hosted RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) chatbot widget for static portfolio sites, built with FastAPI, Ollama (local embeddings and generation) and ChromaDB as a vector store — answering visitor questions grounded in a JSON knowledge base, with zero API costs and no data leaving the host machine.

title: Blog
content: Jerry writes about the projects above as they happen: building this portfolio site with Eleventy and its AI chat widget, running local LLMs with Ollama and LiteLLM, and setting up a two-repo GitLab CI/CD pipeline with Kubernetes using the GitLab Kubernetes Agent. Posts are at /blog/.
